name: Prism
description: Integrates the Prism.js syntax-highlighting library with Drupal via a text-format filter and a dedicated code field type/widget/formatter.
library_dependencies: prism.js + prism.css (the Prism.js library, downloaded manually from https://prismjs.com/download.html into /libraries/prism/)
project_description:
Prism.js is a lightweight, extensible syntax highlighter, built with modern web standards in mind. This module integrates that third-party library with Drupal and provides two independent ways to render highlighted code:

1. A "Highlight code using prism.js" text-format filter (id: prism_filter). It rewrites custom [prism:LANGUAGE]...[/prism:LANGUAGE] blocks into <pre><code class="language-LANGUAGE"> markup and attaches the Prism library. It also detects existing <code> tags (e.g. <pre><code class="language-*"> emitted by a Markdown filter) and attaches the library so those are highlighted too. An "Always include Prism.js library" filter setting forces the assets onto every page the format renders.

2. A text_long_prism field type with a matching widget (a textarea plus a language select) and a prism_default formatter that wraps the stored value in <pre><code class="language-*"> and attaches the library. The set of languages offered in the widget's select is controlled from the module's settings form at /admin/config/content/prism/settings.

The module does NOT bundle the Prism.js library. Both prism.js and prism.css must be downloaded (optionally customised for specific languages/themes) from https://prismjs.com/download.html and placed at /libraries/prism/prism.js and /libraries/prism/prism.css. A hook_requirements check reports the library as missing until those files exist. Assets are always served locally from that path; the module never loads Prism from a CDN.
